newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK exchange says 15 firms in listing process.
newsitem.headline: HK exchange says 15 firms in listing process.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Ltd said on Thursday it was processing listing applications from 15 companies.
As of Wednesday, all 15 companies had submitted advance booking forms for equity and debt securities (A1 forms) and furnished all required and necessary information, the exchange said in a statement.
It did not name the companies.
Another seven companies have been approved by the listing committee of the exchange but were not yet listed, it said.
Another four companies have submitted the A1 forms but their applications were either inactive or on hold, it added.
The exchange said it also received preliminary enquiries from 14 companies but A1 forms had not yet been submitted.
